Choose the appropriate meaning of the given Idiom/Phrase.

Gift of the gab
solution: The meaning of the given idiom is '**Ability to speak impressively**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the meaning of the given idiom: • ​**Gift of the gab**- "**the ability to speak easily and confidently in a way that makes people want to listen to you and believe you**". (आसानी से और आत्मविश्वास से इस तरह से बोलने की क्षमता जिससे लोग आपकी बात सुनना और आप पर विश्वास करना चाहते हैं) • Example: *She's got the **gift of gab**, she should work in sales and marketing.​* • *​*Thus from the explanation given above, we find that the 2ⁿd option is the correct choice. *​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__*** • *​*Origin*- "**This idiom originates from the Middle English word 'gob' which means mouth, and 'gabbe' which means idle talk***".(यह मुहावरा मध्य अंग्रेजी शब्द '*gob*' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है मुंह, और '*gabbe*' जिसका अर्थ है गपशप) 4b:T87a, The correct answer is- '​Do an act of kindness'
